name: Žerůtky (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a yellow band into a blue upper fly part and a red lower hoist part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 20 March 2023 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
